notes: City of Portland free pre-approved detached ADU, shed-roof / post-and-beam-over-crawlspace variant — a single 576 SF dwelling unit with no repetition, so nothing should be scaled. Truth is transcribed from sheet 03 'FOUNDATION POST AND BEAM' (foundation plan, Section View A, Section View B, Detail 1, Detail 2, subfloor installation detail and the 12 foundation plan notes), read as a rendered image. The wall-framing, roof-framing, elevation, window/door-schedule and energy sheets (01, 02, 04-08) are NOT enumerated, so completeness is partial. Three quantities are derived from a single dimension the drawings state outright — the foundation plan dimensions the building 24'-0" x 24'-0" and the cover sheet calls it a 576 SF ADU — so perimeter items are 4 x 24 = 96 LF and the floor plate is 576 SF. Those carry a 0.10 tolerance because waste, overhang and the concrete landing are not accounted for. Everything else has no count or length anywhere on the sheet and is left null rather than scaled off a 1/4" drawing. Sister document bldg-or-portland-adu-gable-slab (not in this corpus) is the slab-on-grade variant of the same program; this one is deliberately the post-and-beam crawlspace version, so a slab-on-grade extraction here is a misread of the foundation system.
